Daily fire-season weather for towns in south-eastern Australia

Source: R/data.R
fire_daily.Rd

Daily maximum temperature and rainfall for every day of every fire season, September to February, from 1950/51 to 2025/26, for each town in fire_towns. The values come from the ERA5 reanalysis.

Usage

fire_daily

Format

A tibble with one row per town and day and 5 columns:

town

Town name; see fire_towns.

season

Fire season, labelled by the year it starts: 2019 is the 2019/20 season, from September 2019 to February 2020.

date

Date, in Australian Eastern time.

tmax

Daily maximum air temperature 2 m above the ground, in °C.

rain

Daily total precipitation, in mm.

Source

ERA5 reanalysis (Hersbach et al. 2023, doi:10.24381/cds.adbb2d47 ), retrieved through the Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (Zippenfenig 2023, doi:10.5281/zenodo.7970649 ) under the CC BY 4.0 licence. Generated using Copernicus Climate Change Service information. Daily values were subset to fire-season months; no other changes were made.

Details

ERA5 values are averages over a grid cell about 25 km across, not readings from a weather station in the town, so they smooth out local extremes. Open-Meteo picks a land grid cell of similar elevation to each town and adjusts temperature to the town's elevation. See data-raw/fire_daily.R in the package source for how the data were downloaded and prepared.
